items.reason: Pembrolizumab is given only in the combination arms ('Part 1b NGM707 plus pembrolizumab (KEYTRUDA®)'), not in all arms and not as GBM standard of care, so rule 3 (soc_backbone) does not apply; with NGM707 it is one of two agents tested together in those arms. Candidate status (and S6) is unaffected either way.

The record has eight EXPERIMENTAL arms (dose escalation/expansion, mono and combination) and none works as a control; the manual defines 'no' as more than one arm with no control and 'not_applicable' only for single-arm trials.

note: NGM707 is given alone in the monotherapy arms (D-F, 1a) and with pembrolizumab in others; both coders coded experimental_combination and regimen combination. GBM patients can enter only escalation/dose-finding parts (no GBM expansion arm).
